subject.title: [Feature]: Overview should show config file path

question: Should the active config file path be shown in Overview, Settings, or both?
rationale: The gateway already exposes the field to admin-scoped clients, but the issue asks for prominent placement and maintainers need to choose the durable UI location before treating the linked implementation as final.

options.title: Show in Overview
options.body: Add a row to the existing Overview snapshot card, matching the issue title and keeping the implementation presentation-only.

options.title: Show in Settings
options.body: Place the value with other configuration controls if maintainers want Overview to remain limited to health/status metrics.

options.title: Show in Both
options.body: Expose the same value in Overview and Settings, accepting broader UI/i18n surface for discoverability.

recommendation.title: Show in Overview
recommendation.body: Add a row to the existing Overview snapshot card, matching the issue title and keeping the implementation presentation-only.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the main Overview view refactor, making them the best history-backed routing candidate for this UI placement question.
